scope: Existing official Thread / REQ22–23 plugin actions and MATURE06 chat successor; no new task, claim or current Release/I01 scope expansion. Current delivery remains first.

skills.discovery: Local find-skills, assistant-ui and clean-code already installed; local versions reused, no installation. Consulted official llms.txt then exact primitive docs; .md unavailable, human-readable pages retrieved.
skills.application: Checked installed library source against public docs; separated view extension from command authority; no duplicate composer or transport. Clean-code review retained the narrow adapter responsibility and identified the missing quote capture boundary rather than adding wrappers.

officialSources.used: Official Root/Viewport/Messages/Footer composition and experimental ID-keyed message rendering.
Selection toolbar belongs inside a Thread root and Quote sets composer quote state; selectable/excluded message regions are explicit.

findings.kind: Design constraint, not current shipped bug
evidence: thread.aui.tsx:84–144 explicit component slots preserve the official Thread structure.
Installed SelectionToolbarQuote.tsx:40–49 directly calls aui.thread.composer().setQuote and clears browser selection.
Installed SelectionToolbarRoot.tsx:90 scopes selected message through the thread root.
findings.implication: A visually correct official Quote button is a composer mutation, so generic plugin button capability or render permission cannot authorize it. Reuse the existing host private authority and current view/draft ownership; avoid exposing a runtime setter or arbitrary DOM callback.

findings.kind: Future feature gap; toolbar currently not mounted, no reproduced defect
evidence: ConversationThread.tsx:209–228 captures draft.text, knowledge, material and message settings before official send; no quote field is captured.
ConversationThread.tsx:125–127 sends/enqueues the captured text and existing structured fields.
ConversationThread.tsx:233–237 persists composer text through its current draft subscription.
findings.implication: Do not mount the upstream Quote primitive and claim an end-to-end quote feature. First decide explicit product representation through the existing allowed contract: visible text insertion with user-visible quoted context, or a separately coordinated structured field. Preserve complete draft, queue, UNKNOWN original body/key and explicit restore semantics. No shared contract changes are authorized by this note.
acceptance: Two split panes: selection and action stay bound to the source message/pane; changing center or disabling extension rejects a stale action.
Quoting while a previous draft A prepares materials cannot mutate A or silently overwrite current draft B.
Explicit send/queue and durable recovery retain exactly the representation shown to the user; unknown retry keeps original frozen payload.
Selection excludes tool controls and file cards; keyboard operation and both themes are tested when this feature is actually taken.

findings.kind: Existing performance successor constraint; no benchmark claim
evidence: thread.aui.tsx renders ThreadPrimitive.Messages and uses content-visibility on message roots.
markdown-text.tsx already uses memoized components and deferred Markdown.
Official docs expose experimental ID-keyed message rendering for custom/windowed lists.
findings.implication: If measured long-thread DOM cost justifies windowing, preserve message ID, official runtime scopes, viewport/footer anchoring, action context, selection and keyboard focus. Existing content-visibility is not a bound on mounted DOM. Do not swap the official Thread for a custom chat shell or upgrade dependencies solely on latest docs. Exact installed export/support and actual multi-pane resource measurements remain prerequisites.

limits: No product import, tests, browser, service, PG, dependency change or project edit.
No measured performance improvement, no UI screenshot and no new feature completion.
Latest documentation is design reference; execution must bind the installed 0.15.23 surface.
